sources.snippet: TransCoder Model Relevant source files Introduction The TransCoder model is the core component of Facebook Research's unsupervised code translation system. It enables automatic translation between programming languages (primarily C++, Java, and Python) without requiring parallel data. sources.title: Facebook Transcoder - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Transcoder was proposed by researchers at Facebook in September 2020 in the paper titled "Unsupervised Translation of Programming Languages". The goal of the project was to train AI to understand the code in a different language and able to convert the code from one language to another.
